title: I am shook.
content: For literal years now, I've gone to the same reoccurring places in my dreams EVERY SINGLE NIGHT. It starts off as a mall, I go upstairs and see a huge Hot Topic. This store is 2 levels and has things like authentic vintage tees, gothic furniture, home goods, etc. it's extravagant. As I'm leaving HT, I'll see a couple of smaller stores that don't have much in them. From there it starts to narrow into a hallway and curve as the hallway is going. This is usually how I get out. Once I'm out, the mall is oceanside with waves crashing and everything. To get back inside the mall, I have to use an underground tunnel system/jungle gym type of thing. Once I'm back In, I realize it's no longer a mall, but a hospital/nursing home, which eventually morphs into a school. And when I leave the school, it's a city with old brick and metal buildings and shops. From here I get on a road that has twists, turns, gaps in the road , ramps, etc. I typically visit my best friends childhood home, sometimes my old home, my grandparents homes, aunts homes, etc.... I literally dream of doing this every night. I found this group today by accident and my mind is blown by some of the stories I've read so far. I have told so many people about my continuous reoccurring dreams and nobody's ever been able to relate. Thanks for reading. Also can someone please tell me what the whole Mall World phenomenon is about?? Like why are we dreaming about this more than once?
